info.title: PoYo AI - Kling 2.6 Motion Control API
info.description: The Kling 2.6 Motion Control API transfers motion from a 3–30 second reference video onto one character image at 720p or 1080p. Image orientation caps the result at 10 seconds; video orientation allows up to 30 seconds.

post.description: Transfer motion from reference videos to character images with precise motion control

input.prompt: The cartoon character is dancing gracefully in a studio

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for result notifications

input.description: Input parameters for motion control generation

prompt.description: Text description of the desired output scene (optional)
prompt.example: The cartoon character is dancing gracefully in a studio

image_urls.description: Single character image URL (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, max 10MB). Must clearly show the subject's head, shoulders, and torso

video_urls.description: Single reference video URL for motion transfer (MP4, MOV, MKV, max 100MB, 3-30 seconds). Must clearly show the subject's head, shoulders, and torso

character_orientation.description: Character orientation mode: 'image' matches the person's orientation in the photograph (max 10 seconds output), 'video' maintains consistency with character orientation from the reference video (max 30 seconds output)

resolution.description: Output video resolution. 720p for standard quality, 1080p for higher visual quality

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier for status tracking

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`
